text:
isabel: Big thanks to @hugo and @marta for the impromptu plant rescue this afternoon. the office sunflower was wilting and you two pulled an all-star save. :sunflower:
hugo: haha team effort! moved it to the east window, watered with distilled (per plant wiki), and trimmed the sad leaves. feels better already.
marta: also organized a tiny care schedule so it won't become my sole responsibility. @devon volunteered to check soil moisture twice a week. :seedling:
devon: happy to help. added a sticky with a care checklist and left a small watering can in the supply shelf.
samir: shoutout to @marta for the handwritten label "office sunflower: thrives on compliments" 60a morale boost. also kudos for coordinating while juggling two meetings.
facilities-bot: Facilities note: East windowsill cleared for plant care. Supplies restocked: watering can (1), soil moisture sticks (5).
isabel: also huge thanks to @hugo for lending his umbrella to the delivery person who got caught in the downpour. small kindness, big ripple. :umbrella:
hugo: umbrella diplomacy is my side gig. saw the poor courier drenched and couldn't not help. no one should miss lunch because of rain.
marta: can we add a tiny "acts of kindness" section to the weekly kudos? these micro-moments deserve shoutouts too.
kudos-bot: Added 2 kudos: hugo (plant + umbrella), marta (plant rescue + coordination). Logged in weekly roundup.
isabel: agreed on the kindness section. i'll start a doc and add today's entries. also leaving a hand-written sticky near the plant with today's rescuers.
devon: tiny PS: if anyone wants to adopt a desk plant, we have a few looking for homes after the office reshuffle. free to a good windowsill.
samir: planting the seeds of kindness, literally. thanks everyone for the quick, thoughtful help today. warms the heart and the office. :heart:
isabel: sending a virtual cookie to @hugo and @marta. i'll drop an actual one in the kitchen. :cookie:
hugo: midnight snack funded. thanks!
facilities-bot: Reminder: if you move plants or equipment, please update the office inventory doc so we can keep track.
marta: noted. adding inventory update now. thanks again team  small acts matter.
kudos-bot: Reminder: add any micro-kudos to the weekly roundup before Friday 5pm.
